text_block_list.name: Baby
text_block_list.text: Eh, eh... waah, waah, waah!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: Ah, there there... what should I do? Maybe we should step out for a bit...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Boooono♪ Sorry to keep everyone waiting~! The next act is starting soon, so please wait just a little longer~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hm? —Ah, a baby! So cute~! But maybe not in a good mood? Then... here! Take this!

text_block_list.name: Jack-in-the-Box
text_block_list.text: (Boioioing!)

text_block_list.name: Baby
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Hehe, hehe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha♪ Surprised? The candy the clown has is for the baby, so go ahead~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: After this, let’s all smile together too♪

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl A
text_block_list.text: Ah! Then I’ll make the costumes! I’m good at sewing! Please let me ask later what kind of design you’d like!

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl B
text_block_list.text: In that case, I’ll handle the lighting. I’ve done a bit of theater before... so I’m familiar with that equipment.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your suggestions. Then, we’ll divide everyone into groups — performers, costumes, props, and so on. Please indicate your preference—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Good. Looks like we’ll have enough people! Now, the next issue is safety — we must ensure a performance that won’t worry the fans.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ah! In that case! I got a marvelous suggestion! —Let’s go☆

text_block_list.name: Circus Member A
text_block_list.text: It went viral, so I watched the magic stream just for fun... but it really hit me! So I thought, maybe I could help with something—

text_block_list.name: Circus Member A
text_block_list.text: When I talked to the leader, they gave permission to use our facility as a practice space! Please make good use of it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank you so much! Hehe. I’m so happy for this wonderful connection.

text_block_list.name: Circus Member A
text_block_list.text: And about the performance too — I’ll teach you anything I can! Feel free to rely on me!

text_block_list.name: Circus Member A
text_block_list.text: Hmm, still a bit off with timing? The left-hand club should be thrown when the first right-hand club is still in the air!

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl C
text_block_list.text: Y-yes...! The right-hand club... in the air...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Watch this! Like this☆ Marvelooooous★☆★

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl C
text_block_list.text: ...So, so beautiful. We’re going to do this too...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. In 5 days, 2 hours, and 24 minutes... I want you to have mastered this performance by then.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Recently, I spoke with the executive committee and secured a chance to showcase the performance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The teachers’ concern is that ‘if we fail the act, we’ll worry the fans.’ In other words, our passing standard is—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Perform the act flawlessly, with a 100% success rate. —Please ensure mastery by the deadline.

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl D
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh!? ...No good, again... What do I do. This is way harder than I thought...

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl D
text_block_list.text: Maybe applying for the performer group was a mistake... I can’t seem to keep up with everyone—

text_block_list.name: Circus Member A
text_block_list.text: Wow! You girls are amazing! You’re learning so fast! Must be because you’re so motivated, huh?

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl D
text_block_list.text: ...I don’t think I can perform that well. Not me.

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl C
text_block_list.text: ...What should I do. I’ll try my best, but... if I drag everyone down...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hello! Are you hungry? I made some food~!

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl D
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was delicious~. A moment of bliss.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha♪ I’m glad~. Feeling a bit better now?

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl C
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Yeah, you’re right. I feel... a little lighter.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: There are times when you lose confidence, right~? Especially when you’re hungry! It’s easy to think ‘maybe I can’t do it’ then.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: But you know what—Not at all! That’s not true! Because you just enjoyed a good meal! You’ll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl D
text_block_list.text: Bono...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And if you still feel uneasy, I want you to tell me or Fuji, okay? —I worry too! Let’s worry together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Because now we’re already comrades who shared the same hotpot! Both worries and joys! Let’s share them all together♪

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl C
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Thanks, Bono... I’ll think properly about what I should do!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, Akebono. —I saw you earlier. Thank you for caring about the new members.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That was a wonderful act of kindness. I’m really glad to have you as part of the team.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪ Yay! I’m so happy I could be of help!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That’s exactly what I wanted to do.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What you wanted to do?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yep! —Hey hey, listen Fuji! I want to become a circus tent!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Everyone brings wonderful feelings when they challenge the circus, right? I want to support those feelings — like a tent!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: A tent is big and wraps everyone up, right? Inside, you can feel safe and warm!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So, a tent is like the hotpot of the circus! Not just for the audience, but for you too, Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —So that everyone can smile. That’s what I want to support.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. I see. That’s very much like you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: After consulting with me recently, I made minor adjustments to the program and divided the performer team into smaller groups to make it easier to share concerns.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Improving the situation quickly is essential to keep the schedule, so... we’ll continue to accept feedback. Thank you for your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yes! We’ll do our best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yep yep. Smiles suit everyone best! Right? —Aha♪
